staticMethods.name: ConcatenateWire
staticMethods.signature: (Wire: TopoDS_Wire, Option: GeomAbs_Shape, AngularTolerance?: number): TopoDS_Wire
staticMethods.comment: this method makes a wire whose edges are C1 from a Wire whose edges could be G1. It removes a vertex between G1 edges. Option can be G1 or C1.

staticMethods.name: ConcatenateWireC0
staticMethods.comment: this method makes an edge from a wire. Junction points between edges of wire may be sharp, resulting curve of the resulting edge may be C0.

staticMethods.name: ConvertWire
staticMethods.signature: (theWire: TopoDS_Wire, theAngleTolerance: number, theFace: TopoDS_Face): TopoDS_Wire

staticMethods.name: ConvertFace
staticMethods.comment: Method of face conversion. The API corresponds to the method ConvertWire. This is a shortcut for calling `ConvertWire()` for each wire in theFace.

staticMethods.name: IsValid
staticMethods.comment: Checks if the shape is "correct". If not, returns <false>, else returns <true>.

staticMethods.name: IsValid
staticMethods.signature: (theArgs: NCollection_List_TopoDS_Shape, theResult: TopoDS_Shape, closedSolid: boolean, GeomCtrl: boolean): boolean
staticMethods.comment: Checks if the Generated and Modified Faces from the shapes <arguments> in the shape <result> are "correct". The args may be empty, then all faces will be checked. If <Closed> is True, only closed shape are valid. If <GeomCtrl> is False the geometry of new vertices and edges are not verified and the auto-intersection of new wires are not searched.

staticMethods.name: IsTopologicallyValid
staticMethods.comment: Checks if the shape is "correct". If not, returns FALSE, else returns TRUE. This method differs from the previous one in the fact that no geometric controls (intersection of wires, pcurve validity) are performed.

instanceMethods.comment: the surface of <F> will be the surface of each new faces built. <Proj> is used to update pcurves on edges if necessary. See `Add()`.

instanceMethods.name: Add

Add the wire <W> to the set of wires.

The edges of <W> can be modified if they don't have pcurves on the surface of <F>. In this case if <Proj> is false the first pcurve of the edge is positioned on . if <Proj> is True, the Pcurve On is the projection of the curve 3d on <F>.

classes.name: BRepAlgo_NormalProjection
classes.summary: This class makes the projection of a wire on a shape.

instanceMethods.name: Add
instanceMethods.comment: Add an edge or a wire to the list of shape to project.

instanceMethods.name: SetParams
instanceMethods.signature: (Tol3D: number, Tol2D: number, InternalContinuity: GeomAbs_Shape, MaxDegree: number, MaxSeg: number): void
instanceMethods.comment: Set the parameters used for computation Tol3d is the required tolerance between the 3d projected curve and its 2d representation InternalContinuity is the order of constraints used for approximation. MaxDeg and MaxSeg are the maximum degree and the maximum number of segment for BSpline resulting of an approximation.

instanceMethods.name: SetDefaultParams
instanceMethods.comment: Set the parameters used for computation in their default values.

instanceMethods.name: SetMaxDistance
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the maximum distance between target shape and shape to project. If this condition is not satisfied then corresponding part of solution is discarded. if MaxDist < 0 then this method does not affect the algorithm.

instanceMethods.name: Compute3d
instanceMethods.comment: if With3d = false the 3dcurve is not computed the initial 3dcurve is kept to build the resulting edges.

instanceMethods.name: SetLimit
instanceMethods.comment: Manage limitation of projected edges.

instanceMethods.name: Build
instanceMethods.comment: Builds the result as a compound.

instanceMethods.name: Projection
instanceMethods.comment: returns the result

instanceMethods.name: Ancestor
instanceMethods.comment: For a resulting edge, returns the corresponding initial edge.

instanceMethods.name: Couple
instanceMethods.comment: For a projected edge, returns the corresponding initial face.

instanceMethods.comment: Returns the list of shapes generated from the shape .

instanceMethods.name: BuildWire
instanceMethods.comment:
build the result as a list of wire if possible in - a first returns a wire only if there is only a wire.
@param Liste Mutated in place; read the updated value from this argument after the call.
